parts:

Seongho

+   radic ~ ideaimplementation + exprisk + sear + acqsil + defsil

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: I can not calculate mediation effect
parts:
Seongho,

Could you tell me what version of blavaan you are using? The development version contains some fairly recent fixes related to ":=", so you might try that if you haven't already:

http://faculty.missouri.edu/~merklee/blavaan/source.html

If that doesn't work, try using "==" instead of ":=" (I believe these operators have slightly different meanings in lavaan, but they should lead to similar results in blavaan). It might also be helpful if you could send data (fake, if necessary) that leads to this error.

Thanks,
Ed
